name: Iceland
prevalence_note: Lögreglan and bank warnings 2025-2026: fake bank staff asking for an approval in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app, fake technical support with AnyDesk, and crypto investment calls.
cross_border_note: Many of these calls come from abroad in English.

scams.name: Falskur bankastarfsmaður: samþykkja rafræn skilríki
scams.name_en: Fake bank staff asking to approve an e-ID request
scams.signals_en: A caller from the bank's security department reports an unusual payment and asks the owner to approve a request in rafræn skilríki or the Auðkenni app or give a security number.
scams.legit_en: Icelandic banks never ask customers to approve an e-ID request they did not start or to give security numbers.
bait_tactics: Segja að síminn sé að endurræsa sig og biðja þá að útskýra aftur í rólegheitum
Spyrja hvaða dag greiðslan var og hversu há

scams.name: Fölsk tækniþjónusta: setja upp forrit
scams.name_en: Fake tech support installing a program
scams.signals_en: A caller from technical support says the computer has a problem or offers a refund and asks to install AnyDesk or a similar program and enter card details.
scams.legit_en: Software companies never call about refunds or viruses and never ask to control a computer.
bait_tactics: Segja að tölvan sé mjög lengi að ræsa sig og spyrja hvað eigi að sjást á skjánum

scams.name: Rafmyntasvik: óinnleyst inneign
scams.signals_en: A caller says the owner has an unclaimed crypto balance or a profitable investment and asks for card details or to log in to online banking to receive it.
scams.legit_en: No real exchange calls about unclaimed balances or asks for online banking access.
bait_tactics: Segja að maður skrifi allt niður og spyrja hversu há inneignin sé
